lines.en: Hi. I'd like to open a bank account, please. Do you have an account for students?
lines.zh: 你好。我想开一个银行账户。你们有学生账户吗？

lines.en: Yes, we do. The student account has no monthly fee. How old are you?
lines.zh: 有的。学生账户没有月费。你多大了？

lines.en: I'm twelve. My host mom Karen is here with me.
lines.zh: 我十二岁。我的寄宿妈妈凯伦陪我来的。

lines.en: Hi. What do we need to bring?
lines.zh: 你好。我们需要带些什么？

lines.en: Her passport and a proof of address. Because she's under eighteen, a parent or guardian needs to sign the form too.
lines.zh: 她的护照和一份地址证明。因为她未满十八岁，家长或监护人也需要在表格上签字。

lines.en: No problem. Here's her passport and a letter with our address.
lines.zh: 没问题。这是她的护照和一封写有我们地址的信。

lines.en: Thank you. Would you also like a savings account?
lines.zh: 谢谢。你还想开一个储蓄账户吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. I want to save money for a new bike.
lines.zh: 好的。我想攒钱买一辆新自行车。

lines.en: Great idea. Your debit card will come in the mail next week.
lines.zh: 好主意。你的借记卡下周会寄过来。

lines.en: Thank you very much!
lines.zh: 非常感谢！

lines.en: Hi. I'd like to deposit some money into my account.
lines.zh: 你好。我想往账户里存一些钱。

lines.en: Sure. How much would you like to deposit?
lines.zh: 好的。你想存多少？

lines.en: Fifty dollars. It's my pocket money from this month.
lines.zh: 五十加元。这是我这个月的零花钱。

lines.en: Good for you! Anything else today?
lines.zh: 真棒！今天还需要办别的吗？

lines.en: Can I exchange Chinese yuan for Canadian dollars?
lines.zh: 我可以把人民币换成加元吗？

lines.en: Yes. How much do you have?
lines.zh: 可以。你有多少？

lines.en: Five hundred yuan. What's the exchange rate today?
lines.zh: 五百元人民币。今天的汇率是多少？

lines.en: Today one yuan is about nineteen cents, so you'll get about ninety-five dollars.
lines.zh: 今天一元人民币大约兑十九分，所以你大概能换到九十五加元。

lines.en: OK. Could I have a receipt, please?
lines.zh: 好的。请给我一张收据好吗？

lines.en: Here you go. It also shows your new balance.
lines.zh: 给你。上面也有你的新余额。

lines.en: How can I check my balance later?
lines.zh: 以后我怎么查余额？

lines.en: You can use our app or any of our ATMs. Just remember your PIN.
lines.zh: 你可以用我们的应用程序，或者我们的任何一台取款机。记住你的密码就行。

lines.en: Karen, how do I take money out of the ATM?
lines.zh: 凯伦，怎么从取款机取钱？

lines.en: First, insert your card here. Then enter your PIN on the keypad.
lines.zh: 先把卡插在这里，然后在键盘上输入密码。

lines.en: Should I cover the keypad?
lines.zh: 我要遮住键盘吗？

lines.en: Yes. Always cover the keypad when you enter your PIN.
lines.zh: 是的。输密码的时候一定要遮住键盘。

lines.en: OK. I'd like to withdraw forty dollars.
lines.zh: 好的。我想取四十加元。

lines.en: Choose "Withdraw," then type the amount.
lines.zh: 选"取款"，然后输入金额。

lines.en: Is there a fee for using this ATM?
lines.zh: 用这台取款机要手续费吗？

lines.en: Not at your own bank. Other banks may charge you two or three dollars.
lines.zh: 在你自己的银行不用。别的银行可能收两三加元。

lines.en: Here's my money. Should I take the receipt?
lines.zh: 钱出来了。我要拿收据吗？

lines.en: Yes. It helps you keep track of your spending.
lines.zh: 要。它能帮你记录自己的花销。

lines.en: Can I tap my card at the grocery store too?
lines.zh: 我在超市也可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Yes, you can. You can even pay with your phone.
lines.zh: 可以。你甚至可以用手机付款。

lines.en: Hello, Maple Bank. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 您好，枫叶银行。有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi. I think I lost my card. I can't find it anywhere.
lines.zh: 你好。我觉得我的卡丢了，哪里都找不到。

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Don't worry, I can help. Can I have your full name and date of birth?
lines.zh: 很遗憾听到这个消息。别担心，我可以帮你。请告诉我你的全名和出生日期。

lines.en: Emma Wang. My date of birth is May 3rd, 2014.
lines.zh: 王艾玛。我的出生日期是2014年5月3日。

lines.en: Thank you, Emma. Would you like me to freeze your card now?
lines.zh: 谢谢你，艾玛。需要我现在帮你冻结这张卡吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Can you freeze my card right away?
lines.zh: 好的。请马上帮我冻结我的卡。

lines.en: Done. Nobody can use it now. Do you see any strange payments on your account?
lines.zh: 好了，现在没人能用它了。你的账户上有奇怪的付款吗？

lines.en: Let me check. No, everything looks normal.
lines.zh: 我看一下。没有，一切正常。

lines.en: Good. Please visit your branch with your ID to get a new card.
lines.zh: 很好。请带上你的身份证件到你的支行领一张新卡。

lines.en: Can I use a credit card instead?
lines.zh: 我可以改用信用卡吗？

lines.en: Sorry, you need to be eighteen for a credit card. Your new debit card will be ready in a few days.
lines.zh: 抱歉，满十八岁才能办信用卡。你的新借记卡几天后就能办好。

lines.en: OK. Thank you for your help.
lines.zh: 好的。谢谢你的帮助。
